// How the store a model's deployments name reaches kcmd skills-generate and
// kcmd profiles: which models still get a skill when the store cannot be
// resolved, and which deployments are refused.

import {afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, mock, spyOn, test} from 'bun:test';
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import * as os from 'node:os';
import * as path from 'node:path';

import {AlloyDbClient} from '../../src/libts/gcp/alloydb';
import {ApiContext} from '../../src/libts/gcp/context';
import {createSemanticRuntimes} from '../../src/libts/semantic/runtime/runtime';
import {profiles, skillsGenerate} from '../../src/tool/commands';

const CTX = new ApiContext('test-project', 'us', 'test-token');
const SPANNER_DB =
    '//spanner.googleapis.com/projects/acme-ops/instances/prod/databases/commerce';
const BQ = '//bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/acme';
const CLUSTER =
    '//alloydb.googleapis.com/projects/acme-ops/locations/us-central1/clusters/main';

let dir = '';
let cwd = '';
let logs: string[] = [];
// What console.log printed, which is the report and --print-store output.
let out: string[] = [];

function writeModel(file: string, text: string): void {
  fs.writeFileSync(
      path.join(dir, 'catalog.yaml'),
      'scope: semantic-model.test-project.us.commerce_eg\n');
  const eg = path.join(dir, 'catalog', 'EntryGroups', 'commerce_eg');
  fs.mkdirSync(eg, {recursive: true});
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(eg, file), text);
}

function model(deployments: string, source: string, actions = true): string {
  return `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
${deployments}    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${source}
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
          - { name: total, expression: Total }
` + (actions ? `    actions:
      - name: IssueCredit
        description: Does a thing to an order.
        executor:
          sql:
            statements:
              - UPDATE Orders SET Total = 0 WHERE OrderId = @order
        parameters:
          - {name: order, type: Integer}
        affects:
          - {concept: Order, operation: modify}
` :
                 '');
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cwd = process.cwd();
  dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'kcmd-runtime-store-'));
  process.chdir(dir);
  logs = [];
  out = [];
  spyOn(ApiContext, 'default').mockReturnValue(CTX);
  spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockImplementation((() => {
    throw new Error('unexpected network call');
  }) as any);
  spyOn(console, 'log').mockImplementation((...a: unknown[]) => {
    out.push(a.join(' '));
    logs.push(a.join(' '));
  });
  for (const channel of ['warn', 'error'] as const) {
    spyOn(console, channel).mockImplementation((...a: unknown[]) => {
      logs.push(a.join(' '));
    });
  }
});

afterEach(() => {
  process.chdir(cwd);
  if (dir) fs.rmSync(dir, {recursive: true, force: true});
  dir = '';
  mock.restore();
});


// A model with no actions gets a skill whose text never names the store, so
// the store cannot be what stops it.
describe('a model with no actions', () => {
  test('gets a skill when its BigQuery tables sit outside the graph dataset',
       async () => {
         writeModel(
             'commerce.yaml',
             model(
                 `      - name: prod\n` +
                     `        target: ${BQ}/datasets/graphs/propertyGraphs/commerce\n`,
                 `${BQ}/datasets/sales/tables/orders`, false));
         expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills'})).toBe(0);
       });

  test('gets a skill when the AlloyDB listing fails', async () => {
    spyOn(AlloyDbClient.prototype, 'listInstances')
        .mockRejectedValue(new Error('fetch failed'));
    writeModel(
        'commerce.yaml',
        model(
            `      - name: alloy\n        target: ${CLUSTER}/databases/commerce\n`,
            `${CLUSTER}/databases/commerce/schemas/public/tables/orders`,
            false));
    expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills'})).toBe(0);
  });
});


// `kcmd profiles` and `kcmd profiles --print-store` read the same binding.
describe('the profiles report and --print-store', () => {
  test('agree on the target of a profile file a deployment names', async () => {
    writeModel(
        'commerce.yaml',
        model(
            `      - name: prod\n` +
                `        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce\n` +
                `        profile: prod\n`,
            `${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders`, false));
    writeModel(
        'commerce.profile.prod.yaml',
        `name: prod\nentities:\n  - name: Order\n    source: ${
            SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders\n`);
    expect(await profiles({printStore: true, profile: 'prod'})).toBe(0);
    expect(out).toEqual(['acme-ops/prod/commerce']);
    out = [];
    await profiles({profile: 'prod'});
    const target = out.find(l => l.trim().startsWith('target:'));
    expect(target).toBe(`    target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce`);
  });

  test('agree on the target of a legacy wrapper', async () => {
    writeModel(
        'commerce.yaml',
        model(
            `      - name: analytical\n` +
                `        target: ${BQ}/datasets/sales/propertyGraphs/commerce\n` +
                `        profile: analytical\n` +
                `      - name: prod\n` +
                `        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce\n`,
            `${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders`, false));
    const eg = path.join(dir, 'catalog', 'EntryGroups', 'commerce_eg');
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(eg, 'commerce.profiles'), {recursive: true});
    for (const name of ['staging', 'analytical']) {
      fs.writeFileSync(
          path.join(eg, 'commerce.profiles', `${name}.yaml`),
          `semantic_model:\n  - name: commerce\n    entities:\n` +
              `      - name: Order\n        source: ${
                  SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders\n`);
    }
    expect(await profiles({printStore: true, profile: 'staging'})).toBe(0);
    expect(out).toEqual(['acme-ops/prod/commerce']);
    out = [];
    await profiles({profile: 'staging'});
    const target = out.find(l => l.trim().startsWith('target:'));
    expect(target).toBe(
        `    target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce`);
  });
});


// Under `default`, a deployment with `profile: default` counts as one that
// names no profile. A legacy wrapper falls back to the same deployments.
describe('a deployment that names profile default', () => {
  test('is the one a legacy wrapper no deployment names falls back to',
       async () => {
         writeModel(
             'commerce.yaml',
             model(
                 `      - name: main\n` +
                     `        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce\n` +
                     `        profile: default\n`,
                 `${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders`, false));
         const eg = path.join(dir, 'catalog', 'EntryGroups', 'commerce_eg');
         fs.mkdirSync(path.join(eg, 'commerce.profiles'), {recursive: true});
         fs.writeFileSync(
             path.join(eg, 'commerce.profiles', 'prod.yaml'),
             `semantic_model:\n  - name: commerce\n    entities:\n` +
                 `      - name: Order\n        source: ${
                     SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders\n`);
         const byDefault = await createSemanticRuntimes({ctx: CTX});
         if ('error' in byDefault) throw new Error(byDefault.error);
         expect(byDefault[0].store?.name)
             .toBe('projects/acme-ops/instances/prod/databases/commerce');
         const wrapped = await createSemanticRuntimes({ctx: CTX, profile: 'prod'});
         if ('error' in wrapped) throw new Error(wrapped.error);
         expect(wrapped[0].storeError).toBeUndefined();
         expect(wrapped[0].store?.name)
             .toBe('projects/acme-ops/instances/prod/databases/commerce');
       });
});


// A legacy wrapper names its target in `deployment_target`. The loader turns
// it into a deployment called `default`, which the author never wrote, so a
// message names the key.
describe('a legacy wrapper whose deployment_target is in no accepted form', () => {
  test('is reported as the wrapper\'s deployment_target', async () => {
    writeModel(
        'commerce.yaml',
        model(
            `      - name: prod\n` +
                `        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce\n`,
            `${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders`, false));
    const eg = path.join(dir, 'catalog', 'EntryGroups', 'commerce_eg');
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(eg, 'commerce.profiles'), {recursive: true});
    fs.writeFileSync(
        path.join(eg, 'commerce.profiles', 'staging.yaml'),
        `semantic_model:\n  - name: commerce\n` +
            `    deployment_target: spanner:graph:acme-ops.regional-us.prod.commerce.commerce\n` +
            `    entities:\n      - name: Order\n        source: ${
                SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders\n`);
    const rt = await createSemanticRuntimes({ctx: CTX, profile: 'staging'});
    if ('error' in rt) throw new Error(rt.error);
    expect(rt[0].storeError).not.toContain("deployment 'default'");
  });
});


// A deployment's `profile` names a profile the model does not declare.
describe('a deployment whose profile is a typo', () => {
  test('is reported', async () => {
    writeModel(
        'commerce.yaml',
        model(
            `      - name: prod\n` +
                `        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce\n` +
                `        profile: prdo\n`,
            `${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders`).replace(/        executor:\n(.*\n){3}/, ''));
    writeModel(
        'commerce.profile.prod.yaml',
        `name: prod\nentities:\n  - name: Order\n    source: ${
            SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders\nactions:\n  - name: IssueCredit\n    executor:\n      sql:\n        statements:\n          - UPDATE Orders SET Total = 0 WHERE OrderId = @order\n`);
    const code = await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills', profile: 'prod'});
    expect(code).toBe(1);
    expect(logs.join('\n')).toContain("profile 'prdo'");
  });
});


// Resolving inheritance throws on a cycle. createSemanticRuntimes returns
// the error, as it does for every other model push refuses before any store.
describe('an inheritance cycle', () => {
  test('is returned as an error, naming the document and the model',
       async () => {
         writeModel('commerce.yaml', `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
    entities:
      - name: A
        extends: [B]
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/A
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: Id }
      - name: B
        extends: [A]
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/B
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: Id }
`);
         const rt = await createSemanticRuntimes({ctx: CTX});
         expect('error' in rt).toBe(true);
         if (!('error' in rt)) return;
         expect(rt.error).toStartWith("[commerce] model 'commerce': ");
         expect(rt.error).toContain('cycle');
       });
});

// Tests for `kcmd skills-generate` (src/tool/commands.ts, skillsGenerate()) --
// what reaches the filesystem, rather than what the generator composes.
//
// The document's own shape is covered in tests/libts/semantic/skills.test.ts,
// which needs no disk. What is under test here is the part that can lose work:
// which directory a skill lands in, what happens to the skill already there,
// and what happens when two models want the same one. It runs in a temp
// working directory with a pinned context, mirroring action.test.ts. The
// store each profile runs against, which a skill reports, is covered here too,
// through createSemanticRuntimes.

import {afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, mock, spyOn, test} from 'bun:test';
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import * as os from 'node:os';
import * as path from 'node:path';

import {AlloyDbClient} from '../../src/libts/gcp/alloydb';
import {ApiContext} from '../../src/libts/gcp/context';
import {readableEntities} from '../../src/libts/semantic/runtime/agent_tools';
import {dialectFor} from '../../src/libts/semantic/runtime/dialect';
import {createSemanticRuntimes} from '../../src/libts/semantic/runtime/runtime';
import {storeLine} from '../../src/libts/semantic/runtime/store';
import {skillsGenerate} from '../../src/tool/commands';

const CTX = new ApiContext('test-project', 'us', 'test-token');

const SPANNER = '//spanner.googleapis.com/projects/acme-ops/instances/prod';

function modelText(name: string, action: string): string {
  return `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: ${name}
    description: Orders and what they are made of.
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER}/databases/commerce/propertyGraphs/commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER}/databases/commerce/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
          - { name: total, expression: Total }
    actions:
      - name: ${action}
        description: Does a thing to an order.
        executor:
          sql:
            statements:
              - UPDATE Orders SET Total = 0 WHERE OrderId = @order
        parameters:
          - {name: order, type: Order}
        affects:
          - {concept: Order, operation: modify}
`;
}

let dir = '';
let cwd = '';
let logs: string[] = [];

function writeModel(file: string, text: string): void {
  fs.writeFileSync(
      path.join(dir, 'catalog.yaml'),
      'scope: semantic-model.test-project.us.commerce_eg\n');
  const eg = path.join(dir, 'catalog', 'EntryGroups', 'commerce_eg');
  fs.mkdirSync(eg, {recursive: true});
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(eg, file), text);
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cwd = process.cwd();
  dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'kcmd-skills-'));
  process.chdir(dir);
  logs = [];
  spyOn(ApiContext, 'default').mockReturnValue(CTX);
  for (const channel of ['log', 'warn', 'error'] as const) {
    spyOn(console, channel).mockImplementation((...a: unknown[]) => {
      logs.push(a.join(' '));
    });
  }
});

afterEach(() => {
  process.chdir(cwd);
  if (dir) fs.rmSync(dir, {recursive: true, force: true});
  dir = '';
  mock.restore();
});


describe('kcmd skills-generate: what lands on disk', () => {
  test('the directory is named for the skill, not for the caller', async () => {
    writeModel('commerce.yaml', modelText('commerce', 'IssueCredit'));
    expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills'})).toBe(0);
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join('skills', 'commerce', 'SKILL.md')))
        .toBe(true);
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(
               'skills', 'commerce', 'references', 'issue-credit.md')))
        .toBe(true);
  });

  test('--name names the skill of a scope with one model', async () => {
    writeModel('commerce.yaml', modelText('commerce', 'IssueCredit'));
    expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills', name: 'orders'})).toBe(0);
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join('skills', 'orders', 'SKILL.md')))
        .toBe(true);
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join('skills', 'commerce'))).toBe(false);
  });

  test('an existing skill is not overwritten without --force', async () => {
    writeModel('commerce.yaml', modelText('commerce', 'IssueCredit'));
    expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills'})).toBe(0);
    logs = [];
    expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills'})).toBe(1);
    expect(logs.join('\n')).toContain('--force');
  });
});


describe('kcmd skills-generate: a broken profile file', () => {
  test('is reported as an error, not thrown', async () => {
    writeModel('commerce.yaml', modelText('commerce', 'IssueCredit'));
    writeModel('commerce.profile.prod.yaml', 'name: staging\n');
    expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills', profile: 'prod'})).toBe(1);
    expect(logs.join('\n')).toContain('commerce.profile.prod.yaml');
  });
});


describe('kcmd skills-generate: a profile file', () => {
  // A profile file names no deployment target, so the skill says there is no
  // store to run its actions against.
  test('has no store', async () => {
    // A `sql` executor names one database's tables, so it lives in the
    // profile.
    writeModel(
        'commerce.yaml',
        modelText('commerce', 'IssueCredit')
            .replace(/        executor:\n(.*\n){3}/, ''));
    writeModel('commerce.profile.prod.yaml', `name: prod
entities:
  - name: Order
    source: ${SPANNER}/databases/commerce_prod/tables/Orders
actions:
  - name: IssueCredit
    executor:
      sql:
        statements:
          - UPDATE Orders SET Total = 0 WHERE OrderId = @order
`);
    expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills', profile: 'prod'})).toBe(0);
    const skill =
        fs.readFileSync(path.join('skills', 'commerce', 'SKILL.md'), 'utf8');
    expect(skill).toContain('Store: none.');
    expect(skill).toContain(
        "binding profile 'prod' is a named profile, which names no deployment " +
        'target');
  });
});


describe('kcmd skills-generate: --force replaces rather than layers', () => {
  test('a page for an action the model dropped is removed', async () => {
    // Progressive disclosure means an agent opens files under references/ on
    // demand. A page left behind by a rename is read as current and describes
    // a call the CLI will reject as unknown.
    writeModel('commerce.yaml', modelText('commerce', 'PlaceOrder'));
    expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills'})).toBe(0);
    const stale =
        path.join('skills', 'commerce', 'references', 'place-order.md');
    expect(fs.existsSync(stale)).toBe(true);

    writeModel('commerce.yaml', modelText('commerce', 'CreateOrder'));
    logs = [];
    expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills', force: true})).toBe(0);
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join(
               'skills', 'commerce', 'references', 'create-order.md')))
        .toBe(true);
    expect(fs.existsSync(stale)).toBe(false);
    expect(logs.join('\n')).toContain('Removed');
  });

  test('a file the generator did not put there is left alone', async () => {
    // Only reference pages are pruned. Anything else under the skill -- a
    // script, a note, a file a later version of this command writes -- is not
    // this command's to delete.
    writeModel('commerce.yaml', modelText('commerce', 'PlaceOrder'));
    expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills'})).toBe(0);
    const note = path.join('skills', 'commerce', 'NOTES.md');
    fs.writeFileSync(note, 'kept');
    expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills', force: true})).toBe(0);
    expect(fs.readFileSync(note, 'utf-8')).toBe('kept');
  });
});


describe('kcmd skills-generate: two models, one name', () => {
  test('a collision is refused rather than silently resolved', async () => {
    // A skill name is a lossy form of a model name. Writing both would leave
    // the second on disk and the first gone, with two "Wrote ..." lines and an
    // exit code of 0 saying otherwise.
    writeModel('a.yaml', modelText('sales-orders', 'PlaceOrder'));
    writeModel('b.yaml', modelText('sales_orders', 'CancelOrder'));
    const code = await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills'});
    expect(code).toBe(1);
    expect(logs.join('\n')).toContain('both name');
    // And neither is on disk. The collision is a fault in the scope, not in
    // one model: whichever happened to be generated first would otherwise be
    // left behind as the answer to a question the command refused to answer.
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join('skills', 'sales-orders'))).toBe(false);
  });
});


// The runtime's store is the one the deployments for the selected profile
// name: those that name it in `profile`, or that name none for `default`.
describe('createSemanticRuntimes: the store a profile uses', () => {
  const SPANNER_DB = `${SPANNER}/databases/commerce`;
  const BQ =
      '//bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/acme-analytics/datasets/sales';
  const CLUSTER =
      '//alloydb.googleapis.com/projects/acme-ops/locations/us-central1/clusters/main';

  beforeEach(() => {
    // Nothing here may reach the network; the AlloyDB listing is mocked.
    spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockImplementation((() => {
      throw new Error('unexpected network call');
    }) as any);
  });

  function logical(deployments: string, source: string): string {
    return `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
${deployments}    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${source}
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`;
  }

  async function runtimeFor(profile?: string) {
    const runtimes = await createSemanticRuntimes(
        {ctx: CTX, ...(profile ? {profile} : {}), onWarning: () => {}});
    if ('error' in runtimes) throw new Error(runtimes.error);
    expect(runtimes).toHaveLength(1);
    return runtimes[0];
  }

  test('each sibling profile file takes the deployment that names it', async () => {
    writeModel(
        'commerce.yaml',
        logical(
            `      - name: bq_prod\n` +
                `        target: ${BQ}/propertyGraphs/commerce\n` +
                `        profile: analytical\n` +
                `      - name: spanner_prod\n` +
                `        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce\n` +
                `        profile: operational\n`,
            `${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders`));
    writeModel(
        'commerce.profile.analytical.yaml',
        `name: analytical\nentities:\n  - name: Order\n    source: ${
            BQ}/tables/orders\n`);
    writeModel(
        'commerce.profile.operational.yaml',
        `name: operational\nentities:\n  - name: Order\n    source: ${
            SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders\n`);

    const analytical = await runtimeFor('analytical');
    expect(analytical.store && storeLine(analytical.store))
        .toBe('bigquery:acme-analytics/sales');
    const operational = await runtimeFor('operational');
    expect(operational.store && storeLine(operational.store))
        .toBe('acme-ops/prod/commerce');
    // Neither deployment is for the model file's own bindings.
    const byDefault = await runtimeFor();
    expect(byDefault.store).toBeUndefined();
    expect(byDefault.storeError)
        .toContain("declares no deployment without a 'profile'");
  });

  // A legacy wrapper that names no `deployment_target` keeps the model file's
  // `deployments:` list. It takes the deployment that names it, and otherwise
  // the ones that name no profile, which is where push deploys it.
  test('a legacy wrapper with no target takes the deployments push uses',
       async () => {
         const eg = path.join(dir, 'catalog', 'EntryGroups', 'commerce_eg');
         fs.mkdirSync(path.join(eg, 'commerce.profiles'), {recursive: true});
         // A deployment may name only a profile the model declares.
         for (const name of ['prod', 'analytical', 'operational']) {
           fs.writeFileSync(
               path.join(eg, 'commerce.profiles', `${name}.yaml`),
               `semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
`);
         }
         const withSpanner = (profileLine: string) => logical(
             `      - name: bq_prod\n` +
                 `        target: ${BQ}/propertyGraphs/commerce\n` +
                 `        profile: analytical\n` +
                 `      - name: spanner_prod\n` +
                 `        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce\n` +
                 profileLine,
             `${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders`);

         writeModel('commerce.yaml', withSpanner(''));
         const unnamed = await runtimeFor('prod');
         expect(unnamed.store && storeLine(unnamed.store))
             .toBe('acme-ops/prod/commerce');

         writeModel('commerce.yaml', withSpanner('        profile: prod\n'));
         const named = await runtimeFor('prod');
         expect(named.store && storeLine(named.store))
             .toBe('acme-ops/prod/commerce');

         writeModel(
             'commerce.yaml', withSpanner('        profile: operational\n'));
         const none = await runtimeFor('prod');
         expect(none.store).toBeUndefined();
         expect(none.storeError)
             .toBe(
                 "legacy binding profile 'prod' names no 'deployment_target', " +
                 "and every deployment in 'deployments' names another profile, " +
                 'so there is no database to run it against');
       });

  test('default with one deployment takes it', async () => {
    writeModel(
        'commerce.yaml',
        logical(
            `      - name: prod\n` +
                `        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce\n`,
            `${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders`));
    const runtime = await runtimeFor();
    expect(runtime.store && storeLine(runtime.store))
        .toBe('acme-ops/prod/commerce');
  });

  test('default with several takes the single operational store', async () => {
    writeModel(
        'commerce.yaml',
        logical(
            `      - name: bq_prod\n` +
                `        target: ${BQ}/propertyGraphs/commerce\n` +
                `      - name: spanner_prod\n` +
                `        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce\n`,
            `${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders`));
    const runtime = await runtimeFor();
    expect(runtime.store && storeLine(runtime.store))
        .toBe('acme-ops/prod/commerce');
  });

  test('several with no single operational store fail, naming them', async () => {
    writeModel(
        'commerce.yaml',
        logical(
            `      - name: spanner_a\n` +
                `        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce\n` +
                `      - name: alloy_b\n` +
                `        target: ${CLUSTER}/databases/commerce\n`,
            `${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders`));
    const runtime = await runtimeFor();
    expect(runtime.store).toBeUndefined();

        .toContain(
            'deployment targets on two operational backends (1 Spanner and ' +

  test('an AlloyDB cluster connects through its primary instance', async () => {

                             'clusters/main/instances/main-primary',
                         instanceType: 'PRIMARY',
                         state: 'READY',
                       }],
                     });
    writeModel(
        'commerce.yaml',
        logical(
            `      - name: alloy_prod\n` +
                `        target: ${CLUSTER}/databases/commerce\n`,
            `${CLUSTER}/databases/commerce/schemas/public/tables/orders`));
    const runtime = await runtimeFor();
    expect(runtime.store && storeLine(runtime.store))
        .toBe('alloydb:acme-ops/us-central1/main/main-primary/commerce');
    expect(list).toHaveBeenCalledWith('acme-ops', 'us-central1', 'main');
  });

  test('an AlloyDB cluster with no primary instance has no store', async () => {
    spyOn(AlloyDbClient.prototype, 'listInstances')
        .mockResolvedValue({status: 200, result: []});
    writeModel(
        'commerce.yaml',
        logical(
            `      - name: alloy_prod\n` +
                `        target: ${CLUSTER}/databases/commerce\n`,
            `${CLUSTER}/databases/commerce/schemas/public/tables/orders`));
    const runtime = await runtimeFor();
    expect(runtime.store).toBeUndefined();
    expect(runtime.storeError)
        .toContain(
            "AlloyDB cluster 'projects/acme-ops/locations/us-central1/" +
            "clusters/main' has no primary instance");
  });

  // A store the model names but cannot reach is a fault to fix, so no skill
  // is written that says the model has none.
  test('skills-generate fails when the AlloyDB lookup fails', async () => {
    spyOn(AlloyDbClient.prototype, 'listInstances')
        .mockRejectedValue(new Error('fetch failed'));

        modelText('commerce', 'IssueCredit')
            .replace(
                `${SPANNER}/databases/commerce/propertyGraphs/commerce`,
                `${CLUSTER}/databases/commerce`)
            .replace(
                `${SPANNER}/databases/commerce/tables/Orders`,
                `${CLUSTER}/databases/commerce/schemas/public/tables/orders`));
    expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills'})).toBe(1);
    expect(logs.join('\n'))
        .toContain(
            "Error: [commerce] Could not list the instances of AlloyDB " +
            "cluster 'projects/acme-ops/locations/us-central1/clusters/main': " +
            'fetch failed');
    expect(fs.existsSync(path.join('skills', 'commerce'))).toBe(false);
  });

  // The model names a store that cannot be resolved, so no skill is written
  // that says it has none.
  test('skills-generate fails when the deployments give no single store',
       async () => {
         const spannerGraph =
             `${SPANNER}/databases/commerce/propertyGraphs/commerce`;
         for (const [second, error] of [
                [
                  'bigquery:graph:acme-analytics.sales.commerce',
                  "deployment 'second' targets " +
                      "'bigquery:graph:acme-analytics.sales.commerce', which " +
                      'is a Knowledge Catalog name',
                ],
                [
                  `${CLUSTER}/databases/commerce`,
                  'deployment targets on two operational backends',

           logs = [];

               'commerce.yaml',

                   .replace(
                       `        target: ${spannerGraph}\n`,
                       `        target: ${spannerGraph}\n` +
                           `      - name: second\n` +
                           `        target: ${second}\n`));
           expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills'})).toBe(1);
           expect(logs.join('\n')).toContain(error);
           expect(fs.existsSync(path.join('skills', 'commerce'))).toBe(false);
         }
       });

  // A vanilla model lists its targets in a GOOGLE block. Push rejects a target
  // in no accepted form and a block that is not JSON, so no skill is written
  // that says the model has no store.
  test('skills-generate fails when a GOOGLE block lists a target in no accepted form or is not JSON',
       async () => {
         const typo = `${SPANNER}/database/commerce/propertyGraphs/commerce`;
         const vanilla = (data: string) => `version: "0.2.0.dev0"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    custom_extensions:
      - vendor_name: GOOGLE
        data: '${data}'
    datasets:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - name: key
            expression: {dialects: [{dialect: ANSI_SQL, expression: OrderId}]}
`;
         const listed = (uris: string[]) =>
             JSON.stringify({deploymentTargets: uris});
         const notAccepted = `Error: Model 'commerce': the GOOGLE ` +
             `custom_extension's 'deploymentTargets' lists '${typo}', which ` +
             'is not a BigQuery graph, a Spanner graph or an AlloyDB database';
         for (const [data, error] of [
                [listed([typo]), notAccepted],
                [
                  listed([`${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce`, typo]),
                  notAccepted,
                ],
                [
                  '{not-json',
                  "Error: Model document 'commerce': Semantic model load " +
                      "error: model 'commerce': the " +
                      "'data' of a GOOGLE custom_extensions block must be a " +
                      'JSON object.',
                ],
              ]) {
           logs = [];
           writeModel('commerce.yaml', vanilla(data));
           expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills'})).toBe(1);
           expect(logs.join('\n')).toContain(error);
           expect(fs.existsSync(path.join('skills', 'commerce'))).toBe(false);
         }
       });

  // A BigQuery graph may read tables in another dataset, and push accepts
  // that. The skill is written, and its store line says there is none.

       async () => {

                         'datasets/raw/tables/orders'));

         const skill = fs.readFileSync(
             path.join('skills', 'commerce', 'SKILL.md'), 'utf8');
         expect(skill).toContain(
             "- Store: none. Model 'commerce' binds 'Order' to " +
             'acme-analytics.raw.orders');
       });

  test('a skill generated from a profile file names that profile\'s store',
       async () => {
         writeModel(
             'commerce.yaml',
             modelText('commerce', 'IssueCredit')
                 .replace(/        executor:\n(.*\n){3}/, '')
                 .replace(
                     '      - name: prod\n',
                     '      - name: prod\n        profile: prod\n'));
         writeModel('commerce.profile.prod.yaml', `name: prod

  - name: Order
    source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders

  - name: IssueCredit
    executor:
      sql:
        statements:
          - UPDATE Orders SET Total = 0 WHERE OrderId = @order

         expect(await skillsGenerate({out: 'skills', profile: 'prod'})).toBe(0);
         const skill = fs.readFileSync(

         expect(skill).toContain('- Store: `acme-ops/prod/commerce`');

describe('createSemanticRuntimes: a column binding is read in the store\'s SQL', () => {
  const CLUSTER =
      '//alloydb.googleapis.com/projects/acme-ops/locations/us-central1/clusters/main';
  const SPANNER_DB = `${SPANNER}/databases/commerce`;

  beforeEach(() => {
    spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockImplementation((() => {
      throw new Error('unexpected network call');
    }) as any);
    spyOn(AlloyDbClient.prototype, 'listInstances').mockResolvedValue({
      status: 200,
      result: [{
        name: 'projects/acme-ops/locations/us-central1/clusters/main/' +
            'instances/main-primary',
        instanceType: 'PRIMARY',
        state: 'READY',
      }],
    });
  });

  // A supertype, and a subtype that inherits its field `flags`.
  function hierarchy(target: string, table: (name: string) => string,
                     flags: string): string {
    return `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${target}
    entities:
      - name: person
        source: ${table('person')}
        primary_key: [id]
        fields:
          - { name: id, expression: id }
          - { name: flags, expression: ${JSON.stringify(flags)} }
      - name: customer
        extends: [person]
        source: ${table('customer')}
        primary_key: [id]
`;
  }

  async function columns() {
    const runtimes = await createSemanticRuntimes({ctx: CTX, onWarning: () => {}});
    if ('error' in runtimes) throw new Error(runtimes.error);
    const [runtime] = runtimes;
    return Object.fromEntries(
        readableEntities(runtime, dialectFor(runtime.store))
            .map(r => [r.entity.name, r.fields.map(f => f.column)]));
  }

  test('PostgreSQL reads `#` as an operator, on every entity that has the field', async () => {
    const alloyDb = (flags: string) => hierarchy(
        `${CLUSTER}/databases/commerce`,
        name => `${CLUSTER}/databases/commerce/schemas/public/tables/${name}`,
        flags);
    writeModel('commerce.yaml', alloyDb('flags # mask'));
    expect(await columns()).toEqual({person: ['id'], customer: ['id']});
    writeModel('commerce.yaml', alloyDb('flags -- a note'));
    expect(await columns())
        .toEqual({person: ['id', 'flags'], customer: ['id', 'flags']});
  });

  test('an AlloyDB store reads the text that database runs', async () => {
    // The BIGQUERY entry is the text the BigQuery graph writes. An AlloyDB
    // database runs the ALLOYDB entry, or else the ANSI_SQL one. A field with
    // neither, such as one with only a POSTGRES entry, keeps its binding.
    const model = (amount: string) => hierarchy(
        `${CLUSTER}/databases/commerce`,
        name => `${CLUSTER}/databases/commerce/schemas/public/tables/${name}`,
        'flags').replace(
        '          - { name: flags, expression: "flags" }\n',
        `          - name: amount\n            expression:\n              dialects: ${amount}\n`);
    writeModel('commerce.yaml', model(
        '[{dialect: BIGQUERY, expression: "amount_usd -- in dollars"}, ' +
        '{dialect: ALLOYDB, expression: amount_cents}]'));
    expect(await columns())
        .toEqual({person: ['id', 'amount_cents'], customer: ['id', 'amount_cents']});
    writeModel('commerce.yaml', model(
        '[{dialect: BIGQUERY, expression: amount_usd}, ' +
        '{dialect: ANSI_SQL, expression: amount_cents}]'));
    expect(await columns())
        .toEqual({person: ['id', 'amount_cents'], customer: ['id', 'amount_cents']});
    writeModel('commerce.yaml', model(
        '[{dialect: POSTGRES, expression: "amount -- in cents"}]'));
    expect(await columns())
        .toEqual({person: ['id', 'amount'], customer: ['id', 'amount']});
  });

  test('GoogleSQL reads `#` as a comment', async () => {
    writeModel('commerce.yaml', hierarchy(
        `${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce`,
        name => `${SPANNER_DB}/tables/${name}`, 'flags # a note'));
    expect(await columns())
        .toEqual({person: ['id', 'flags'], customer: ['id', 'flags']});
  });
});

// Push and the commands that read a model's store agree on a model's
// deployments and profile files. Each case writes one scope and runs
// `kcmd push --validate-only`, the `kcmd profiles` report,
// `kcmd profiles --print-store` and `kcmd skills-generate` over it. On
// deployments and profile files, no runtime command accepts a model push
// rejects, and none rejects a model push accepts, apart from a few cases. The
// docs describe a deployment that names a profile, `default` included, a
// profile file that no deployment uses, an AlloyDB target and several
// targets. Push also accepts a Spanner model that binds a table outside its
// database today. The runtime refuses it on purpose: a write would land in
// the target database's table of that name, so --print-store gives no store
// and skills-generate fails for a model with actions.
//
// Of push's checks on the model itself, the runtime runs only the one on
// inheritance. A model that push refuses for an entity with no source, a
// relationship with no join columns, a key that is not a column, or a broken
// expression, action or constraint still gets a store and a skill. So does a
// model whose deployment breaks the rules of its engine, or whose model file
// binds a field with no text in the dialect of its entity's source. Like push,
// the runtime loads every profile file except a legacy wrapper of a profile
// it does not read. It does not run push's checks that every named profile
// applies to the model, is complete and has valid keys and join columns. So a
// model whose profile file or GOOGLE block profile those checks refuse still
// gets a store and a skill under the default profile. The runtime skips the
// checks of push's Knowledge Catalog leg: one model per entry group, and with
// KC_V2_ASPECTS off the checks on the copies of the model and profile files,
// such as whether each is valid UTF-8. Two models that deploy to one graph
// each get a skill.
//
// Live checks are mocked, and no case reaches the network.

import {afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, mock, spyOn, test} from 'bun:test';
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import * as os from 'node:os';
import * as path from 'node:path';

import {AlloyDbClient} from '../../src/libts/gcp/alloydb';
import {ApiContext} from '../../src/libts/gcp/context';
import {CatalogClient} from '../../src/libts/gcp/dataplex';
import * as kc from '../../src/libts/semantic/deploy_knowledge_catalog';
import * as validateMod from '../../src/libts/semantic/validate';
import {profiles, push, skillsGenerate} from '../../src/tool/commands';

const CTX = new ApiContext('test-project', 'us', 'test-token');

const SPANNER_DB =
    '//spanner.googleapis.com/projects/acme-ops/instances/prod/databases/commerce';
const BQ = (dataset: string) =>
    `//bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/acme/datasets/${dataset}`;

let dir = '';
let cwd = '';
let logs: string[] = [];
let savedV2Aspects: string|undefined;

function eg(): string {
  return path.join(dir, 'catalog', 'EntryGroups', 'commerce_eg');
}

function writeScope(files: Record<string, string>): void {
  fs.writeFileSync(
      path.join(dir, 'catalog.yaml'),
      'scope: semantic-model.test-project.us.commerce_eg\n');
  fs.mkdirSync(eg(), {recursive: true});
  for (const [name, text] of Object.entries(files)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(eg(), name)), {recursive: true});
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(eg(), name), text);
  }
}

type Outcome = {code: number|string; out: string};

// Runs the four commands over the scope, under `profile` when given.
async function runAll(profile?: string): Promise<Record<string, Outcome>> {
  const p = profile ? {profile} : {};
  const out = path.join(dir, 'skills-out');
  const commands: Array<[string, () => Promise<number>]> = [
    ['push', () => push({validateOnly: true, ...p})],
    ['report', () => profiles({...p})],
    ['printStore', () => profiles({printStore: true, ...p})],
    ['skills', () => skillsGenerate({out, ...p})],
  ];
  const results: Record<string, Outcome> = {};
  for (const [name, run] of commands) {
    logs = [];
    let code: number|string;
    try {
      code = await run();
    } catch (e: any) {
      code = `threw: ${e?.message ?? e}`;
    }
    results[name] = {code, out: logs.join('\n')};
    fs.rmSync(out, {recursive: true, force: true});
  }
  return results;
}

function codes(r: Record<string, Outcome>): Record<string, number|string> {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(r).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.code]));
}

beforeEach(() => {
  cwd = process.cwd();
  dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'kcmd-store-agreement-'));
  process.chdir(dir);
  logs = [];
  savedV2Aspects = process.env.KC_V2_ASPECTS;
  delete process.env.KC_V2_ASPECTS;
  spyOn(ApiContext, 'default').mockReturnValue(CTX);
  for (const channel of ['log', 'warn', 'error'] as const) {
    spyOn(console, channel).mockImplementation((...a: unknown[]) => {
      logs.push(a.join(' '));
    });
  }
  spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockImplementation((async () => {
    throw new Error('a test made a network call');
  }) as any);
  // Push's live checks and its Knowledge Catalog leg. Their local checks run
  // before them, in prepareModels.
  spyOn(CatalogClient.prototype, 'getEntryType')
      .mockResolvedValue({status: 200, result: {}} as any);
  spyOn(CatalogClient.prototype, 'getAspectType')
      .mockResolvedValue({status: 200, result: {}} as any);
  spyOn(validateMod, 'validateBigQueryDataSources').mockResolvedValue([]);
  spyOn(validateMod, 'validateBigQueryActionStatements').mockResolvedValue([]);
  spyOn(validateMod, 'validateSpannerActionStatements').mockResolvedValue([]);
  spyOn(kc, 'deployKnowledgeCatalog').mockResolvedValue({
    success: true,
    warnings: [],
    plan: [],
    created: 0,
    updated: 0,

  } as any);
});

afterEach(() => {

    delete process.env.KC_V2_ASPECTS;
  } else {
    process.env.KC_V2_ASPECTS = savedV2Aspects;
  }
  process.chdir(cwd);
  if (dir) fs.rmSync(dir, {recursive: true, force: true});
  dir = '';
  mock.restore();
});


// The control: one Spanner deployment, every source in its database.
describe('control', () => {
  test('a Spanner model every command accepts', async () => {
    writeScope({'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"

// A BigQuery graph lives in one dataset and may read tables in another, or a
// BigLake table. Push accepts both, since all of BigQuery is one database.
// The runtime takes the graph's dataset as the store and gives no store for
// such a model, and skills-generate still writes the skill.
describe('a BigQuery model whose tables sit outside the graph dataset', () => {
  function bigQueryModel(source: string): string {
    return `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${BQ('graphs')}/propertyGraphs/commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${source}
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: order_id }

  test('a table in another dataset: push accepts, so skills-generate does too',
       async () => {
         writeScope({'commerce.yaml': bigQueryModel(`${BQ('raw')}/tables/orders`)});
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(r.push.code).toBe(0);
         expect(r.report.code).toBe(0);
         expect(r.skills.out).not.toContain('Error:');
         expect(r.skills.code).toBe(0);
       });

  test('a BigLake table: push accepts, so skills-generate does too',
       async () => {

               '//biglake.googleapis.com/projects/acme/catalogs/lake/' +
               'namespaces/sales/tables/orders'),
         });

         expect(r.push.code).toBe(0);
         expect(r.report.code).toBe(0);
         expect(r.skills.out).not.toContain('Error:');
         expect(r.skills.code).toBe(0);
       });
});

  - name: commerce

      - vendor_name: GOOGLE
        data: '{"deploymentTargets": ["  ", ""]}'
    datasets:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - name: key
            expression: {dialects: [{dialect: ANSI_SQL, expression: OrderId}]}
`});
    const r = await runAll();
    expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 0, report: 0, printStore: 1, skills: 0});
    expect(r.printStore.out).toContain('declares no deployment target');
    expect(r.skills.out).not.toContain('Error:');
  });
});


// A vanilla model's GOOGLE block lists a BigQuery target twice beside a
// Spanner target. The Spanner target alone would give a store, and every push
// refuses the repeat.
describe('a vanilla GOOGLE block that lists a target twice', () => {
  test('beside a Spanner target, push rejects it, so skills-generate does too',
       async () => {
         const graph = `${BQ('graphs')}/propertyGraphs/commerce`;
         writeScope({'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    custom_extensions:
      - vendor_name: GOOGLE
        data: '{"deploymentTargets": ["${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce", "${graph}", "${graph}"]}'
    datasets:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - name: key
            expression: {dialects: [{dialect: ANSI_SQL, expression: OrderId}]}
`});
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
         expect(r.printStore.out)
             .toContain(`declares duplicate deployment target '${graph}'`);
         expect(r.skills.out)
             .toContain(`declares duplicate deployment target '${graph}'`);
       });

  // A resource name and its URI name the same target, so listing the graph
  // once each way is a repeat too.
  test('once as its URI and once as its resource name, every command refuses',
       async () => {
         const graph = `${BQ('graphs')}/propertyGraphs/commerce`;
         const name = graph.slice(2);
         writeScope({'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    custom_extensions:
      - vendor_name: GOOGLE
        data: '{"deploymentTargets": ["${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce", "${graph}", "${name}"]}'
    datasets:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - name: key
            expression: {dialects: [{dialect: ANSI_SQL, expression: OrderId}]}
`});
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
         expect(r.printStore.out)
             .toContain(`declares duplicate deployment target '${name}'`);
         expect(r.skills.out)
             .toContain(`declares duplicate deployment target '${name}'`);
       });
});


// A legacy wrapper that sets `deployment_target` to an empty string. Push
// reads no graph target and publishes to Knowledge Catalog only, and the
// loader makes no deployment of it.
describe('a legacy wrapper with an empty deployment_target', () => {
  test('push accepts it, so skills-generate does too', async () => {
    writeScope({
      'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`,
      'commerce.profiles/prod.yaml': `semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployment_target: ""
    entities:
      - name: Order

`,

  });

// An entity extends one the model does not declare. The loader lets it
// through, and push reports it when it resolves inheritance.
describe('an entity that extends an unknown entity', () => {
  test('push rejects it, so skills-generate does too, naming the model',
       async () => {
         writeScope({'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        extends: [Missing]
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`});
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
         for (const name of ['push', 'printStore', 'skills']) {
           expect(r[name].out).toContain("model 'commerce'");
           expect(r[name].out)
               .toContain("entity 'Order' extends unknown entity 'Missing'");
         }
       });
});


// A cycle, and a field two unrelated ancestors both declare. Push reports
// each when it resolves inheritance, and so does the runtime.
describe('an inheritance cycle or an ambiguous inherited field', () => {
  const cases: Array<[string, string, string]> = [
    ['a cycle', `      - name: A
        extends: [B]
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/A
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: Id }
      - name: B
        extends: [A]
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/B
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: Id }
`, "'extends' must not form a cycle"],
    ['an ambiguous field', `      - name: P
        abstract: true
        fields:
          - { name: f, datatype: string }
      - name: Q
        abstract: true
        fields:
          - { name: f, datatype: string }
      - name: C
        extends: [P, Q]
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/C
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: Id }
          - { name: f, expression: F }
`, "inherits field 'f' from 'P' and from 'Q'"],
  ];
  for (const [label, entities, message] of cases) {
    test(`${label}: push rejects it, so skills-generate does too`, async () => {
      writeScope({'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
    entities:
${entities}`});
      const r = await runAll();
      expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
      for (const name of ['push', 'printStore', 'skills']) {
        expect(r[name].out).toContain("model 'commerce'");
        expect(r[name].out).toContain(message);
      }
    });
  }
});

// The differences the docs describe, and cases where every command agrees.
describe('documented divergences', () => {
  test('a deployment that names a declared profile: push refuses, the runtime uses it',
       async () => {
         writeScope({
           'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
        profile: prod
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`,
           'commerce.profile.prod.yaml': `name: prod
entities:
  - name: Order
    source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
`,
         });
         const r = await runAll('prod');
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 0, skills: 0});
         expect(r.printStore.out).toBe('acme-ops/prod/commerce');
       });

  test('Spanner beside BigQuery: push refuses two, the runtime takes Spanner',
       async () => {
         writeScope({'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: sp
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
      - name: bq
        target: ${BQ('graphs')}/propertyGraphs/commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`});
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 0, skills: 0});
       });

  test('a vanilla GOOGLE block with two Spanner targets: every command refuses',
       async () => {
         writeScope({'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    custom_extensions:
      - vendor_name: GOOGLE
        data: '{"deploymentTargets": ["${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/a", "${SPANNER_DB}2/propertyGraphs/b"]}'
    datasets:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - name: key
            expression: {dialects: [{dialect: ANSI_SQL, expression: OrderId}]}
`});
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
         expect(r.skills.out).toContain(
             "in its GOOGLE block's 'deploymentTargets'");
       });

  test('a vanilla GOOGLE block with no target: none of the four says deployments',
       async () => {
         writeScope({'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    custom_extensions:
      - vendor_name: GOOGLE
        data: '{"deploymentTargets": []}'
    datasets:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - name: key
            expression: {dialects: [{dialect: ANSI_SQL, expression: OrderId}]}
`});
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 0, report: 0, printStore: 1, skills: 0});
         expect(r.printStore.out).toContain(
             "declares no deployment target in its GOOGLE block's " +
             "'deploymentTargets'");
         expect(r.printStore.out).not.toContain("Declare one deployment");
       });

  test('a duplicate target: the loader refuses it for every command', async () => {
    writeScope({'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: a
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
      - name: b
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
        profile: prod
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`});
    const r = await runAll();
    expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
  });

  test('a malformed deployment beside a valid one for the same profile: every command refuses',
       async () => {
         writeScope({'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: a
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
      - name: b
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraph/typo
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`});
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
       });

  // A model with a deployment dev for default, and a deployment prod for the
  // declared profile prod.
  function devAndProd(prodTarget: string): Record<string, string> {
    return {
      'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: dev
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
      - name: prod
        target: ${prodTarget}
        profile: prod
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`,
      'commerce.profile.prod.yaml': `name: prod
entities:
  - name: Order
    source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
`,
    };
  }

  test('a malformed deployment for another declared profile: every command refuses',
       async () => {
         writeScope(devAndProd(`${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraph/typo`));
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
         expect(r.printStore.out).toContain("deployment 'prod' targets");
         expect(r.skills.out).toContain("deployment 'prod' targets");
       });

  // Push refuses a deployment that names a profile, whatever its target. The
  // runtime uses dev, as the docs say.
  test('a valid deployment for another declared profile: push refuses, the runtime uses dev',
       async () => {
         writeScope(devAndProd(`${SPANNER_DB}2/propertyGraphs/commerce`));
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 0, skills: 0});
         expect(r.printStore.out).toBe('acme-ops/prod/commerce');
       });

  test('a malformed deployment for default under a profile file: every command refuses',
       async () => {
         writeScope({
           'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: dev
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraph/typo
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`,
           'commerce.profile.prod.yaml': `name: prod
entities:
  - name: Order
    source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
`,
         });
         const r = await runAll('prod');
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
         expect(r.printStore.out).toContain("deployment 'dev' targets");
         expect(r.skills.out).toContain("deployment 'dev' targets");
       });

  test('a legacy profile named default in any letter case: every command refuses',
       async () => {
         const reserved = "a binding profile may not be named 'default'";
         for (const file of ['Default.yaml', 'default.yaml']) {
           fs.rmSync(path.join(dir, 'catalog'), {recursive: true, force: true});
           writeScope({
             'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`,
             [`commerce.profiles/${file}`]: `semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
`,
           });
           for (const profile of [undefined, 'Default']) {
             const r = await runAll(profile);
             expect(codes(r))
                 .toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
             expect(r.printStore.out).toContain(reserved);
             expect(r.skills.out).toContain(reserved);
           }
         }
       });

  // Push and the report read every model's profile files first. A file whose
  // `name:` does not match its file name throws there, and the CLI prints the
  // error and exits 1.
  test('a profile file whose name does not match its file name: every command refuses',
       async () => {
         writeScope({
           'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`,
           'commerce.profile.prod.yaml': `name: prd
entities:
  - name: Order
    source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
`,
         });
         const mismatch = "Profile file 'commerce.profile.prod.yaml' declares " +
             "name 'prd', which does not match filename suffix 'prod'.";
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({
           push: `threw: ${mismatch}`,
           report: `threw: ${mismatch}`,
           printStore: 1,
           skills: 1,
         });
         expect(r.printStore.out).toBe(`Error: ${mismatch}`);
         expect(r.skills.out).toBe(`Error: ${mismatch}`);
       });

  // Push checks every profile file, whichever profile it deploys, so under the
  // default profile it refuses a profile file that names an entity the model
  // lacks. The report refuses it too. The runtime applies only the profile it
  // is given, so --print-store and skills-generate accept the file.
  test('a profile file that does not apply: push refuses it under default, the runtime accepts it',
       async () => {
         writeScope({
           'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`,
           'commerce.profile.prod.yaml': `name: prod
entities:
  - name: Nope
    source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
`,
         });
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 0, skills: 0});
         expect(r.push.out).toContain(
             "Error: [commerce.profile.prod.yaml] profile 'prod': entity " +
             "'Nope' is not in the logical model");
         expect(r.report.out).toContain("entity 'Nope' is not in the logical model");
       });

  // Push and the runtime load every profile file except a legacy wrapper,
  // whichever profile they read. A file in <model>.profiles/ takes its
  // profile name from its file name, and loading it checks the `name:`
  // inside it.
  test('a file in <model>.profiles/ whose name does not match its file name: every command refuses',
       async () => {
         writeScope({
           'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`,
           'commerce.profiles/prod.yaml': `name: prd
entities:
  - name: Order
    source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
`,
         });
         const mismatch = "[commerce.profiles/prod.yaml] profile 'prod' " +
             "declares name 'prd', which does not match its file's profile " +
             "name 'prod'";
         for (const r of [await runAll(), await runAll('prod')]) {
           expect(codes(r))
               .toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
           expect(r.push.out).toContain(`Error: ${mismatch}`);
           expect(r.printStore.out).toBe(`Error: ${mismatch}`);
           expect(r.skills.out).toContain(`Error: ${mismatch}`);
         }
       });

  test('a profile file that sets a key a profile may not set: every command refuses',
       async () => {
         writeScope({
           'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`,
           'commerce.profile.prod.yaml': `name: prod
bogus: 1
entities:
  - name: Order
    source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
`,
         });
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r))
             .toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
         expect(r.printStore.out)
             .toContain("[commerce.profile.prod.yaml] profile 'prod'");
         expect(r.push.out).toContain(r.printStore.out);
         expect(r.skills.out).toBe(r.printStore.out);
       });

  // Push loads the model files before the profile files it does not apply.
  // When both fail to load, every command gives the model file's error.
  test('a model file and a profile file that both fail to load: every command gives the model file error',
       async () => {
         writeScope({
           'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    bogus_model_key: 1
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`,
           'commerce.profile.prod.yaml': 'name: prod\nbogus: 1\n',
         });
         const r = await runAll();
         for (const k of ['push', 'printStore', 'skills']) {
           expect(r[k].code).toBe(1);
           expect(r[k].out).toContain("Error: Model document 'commerce'");
           expect(r[k].out).not.toContain("sets 'bogus'");
         }
       });

  test('a profile file that is not valid UTF-8: push refuses its copy, the runtime reads it',
       async () => {
         writeScope({'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`});
         fs.writeFileSync(
             path.join(eg(), 'commerce.profile.prod.yaml'),
             Buffer.concat([
               Buffer.from('name: prod\n# '),
               Buffer.from([0xff]),
               Buffer.from(
                   `\nentities:\n  - name: Order\n    source: ${
                       SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders\n`),
             ]));
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 0, skills: 0});
         expect(r.push.out).toContain('is not valid UTF-8');
       });

  test('a deployment that names profile default: push refuses, the runtime uses it',
       async () => {
         writeScope({'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
        profile: default
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`});
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 0, skills: 0});
         expect(r.printStore.out).toBe('acme-ops/prod/commerce');
       });

  test('a profile file no deployment uses: push refuses, skills-generate writes a skill with no store',
       async () => {
         writeScope({
           'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`,
           'commerce.profile.prod.yaml': `name: prod
entities:
  - name: Order
    source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
`,
         });
         const r = await runAll('prod');
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 0});
         expect(r.push.out).toContain("binding profile 'prod' is a named profile");
       });

  test('a logical model with no deployments: push and skills-generate accept it',
       async () => {
         writeScope({'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    entities:
      - name: Order
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key }
`});
         const r = await runAll();
         expect(codes(r)).toEqual({push: 0, report: 0, printStore: 1, skills: 0});
       });
});


// The report and --print-store describe one profile's store the same way.
describe('kcmd profiles: the report and --print-store on one profile', () => {
  test('the report names the target --print-store prints', async () => {
    writeScope({
      'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce
        profile: prod
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`,
      'commerce.profile.prod.yaml': `name: prod
entities:
  - name: Order
    source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
`,
    });
    const r = await runAll('prod');
    expect(r.printStore.out).toBe('acme-ops/prod/commerce');
    expect(r.report.out).not.toContain(
        'target: (none; a profile file names no deployment target)');
    expect(r.report.out).toContain(
        `target: ${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce`);
  });
});


// --print-store and skills-generate --name refuse a scope of several models
// before they look up any AlloyDB cluster in it.
describe('--print-store and skills-generate --name over several models', () => {
  test('refuse before any AlloyDB lookup', async () => {
    const list = spyOn(AlloyDbClient.prototype, 'listInstances')
                     .mockResolvedValue({status: 200, result: []});
    const cluster =
        '//alloydb.googleapis.com/projects/acme/locations/us-central1/clusters/main';
    const alloy = (name: string) => `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: ${name}
    deployments:
      - name: prod
        target: ${cluster}/databases/${name}
    entities:
      - name: Order
        source: ${cluster}/databases/${name}/schemas/public/tables/orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: order_id }
`;
    writeScope({'a.yaml': alloy('a'), 'b.yaml': alloy('b')});
    logs = [];
    expect(await profiles({printStore: true})).toBe(1);
    expect(logs.join('\n')).toContain('this scope holds 2 models');
    expect(list).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    logs = [];
    const out = path.join(dir, 'skills-out');
    expect(await skillsGenerate({out, name: 'custom'})).toBe(1);
    expect(logs.join('\n')).toContain(
        '--name applies to one skill, and this scope has 2 models');
    expect(list).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    // Without --name, skills-generate looks up the cluster.
    await skillsGenerate({out});
    expect(list).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});


// A vanilla model carries its profiles, deployments and `extends` in GOOGLE
// blocks. Each case writes the Google-flavor scope, with deployments and a
// profile file, then the equivalent vanilla scope, and expects every command
// to give the same result for both.
describe('a vanilla model with GOOGLE blocks agrees with the Google flavor', () => {
  type Deployment = {name: string; target: string; profile?: string};

  const prodProfile = `name: prod
entities:
  - name: Order
    source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
`;

  function googleScope(deployments: Deployment[], extendsList?: string[]):
      Record<string, string> {
    const lines = deployments.map(
        d => `      - name: ${d.name}\n        target: ${d.target}\n` +
            (d.profile ? `        profile: ${d.profile}\n` : ''));
    return {
      'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0/google"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    deployments:
${lines.join('')}    entities:
      - name: Order
${extendsList ? `        extends: [${extendsList.join(', ')}]\n` : ''}\
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
        fields:
          - { name: key, expression: OrderId }
`,
      'commerce.profile.prod.yaml': prodProfile,
    };
  }

  function vanillaScope(deployments: Deployment[], extendsList?: string[]):
      Record<string, string> {
    const model = JSON.stringify({
      profiles: [{
        name: 'prod',
        entities: [{name: 'Order', source: `${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders`}],
      }],
      deployments,
    });
    const dataset = extendsList ?
        `        custom_extensions:
          - vendor_name: GOOGLE
            data: '${JSON.stringify({extends: extendsList})}'
` :
        '';
    return {
      'commerce.yaml': `version: "0.2.0.dev0"
semantic_model:
  - name: commerce
    custom_extensions:
      - vendor_name: GOOGLE
        data: '${model}'
    datasets:
      - name: Order
        source: ${SPANNER_DB}/tables/Orders
        primary_key: [key]
${dataset}        fields:
          - name: key
            expression: {dialects: [{dialect: ANSI_SQL, expression: OrderId}]}
`,
    };
  }

  // Runs the four commands over each flavor's scope, in a fresh directory.
  async function bothFlavors(
      deployments: Deployment[], profile?: string, extendsList?: string[]):
      Promise<{google: Record<string, Outcome>; vanilla: Record<string, Outcome>}> {
    writeScope(googleScope(deployments, extendsList));
    const google = await runAll(profile);
    fs.rmSync(path.join(dir, 'catalog'), {recursive: true, force: true});
    writeScope(vanillaScope(deployments, extendsList));
    const vanilla = await runAll(profile);
    return {google, vanilla};
  }

  const dev = {name: 'dev', target: `${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce`};
  const prod = (target: string) => ({name: 'prod', target, profile: 'prod'});

  // The runtime checks that each deployment's profile is declared. A vanilla
  // model declares prod in its GOOGLE block.
  test('a deployment for a declared profile, under default: the runtime uses dev',
       async () => {
         const {google, vanilla} = await bothFlavors(
             [dev, prod(`${SPANNER_DB}2/propertyGraphs/commerce`)]);
         expect(codes(google))
             .toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 0, skills: 0});
         expect(codes(vanilla)).toEqual(codes(google));
         // The vanilla expression form adds a dialect warning on its own line.
         expect(vanilla.printStore.out.split('\n').pop())
             .toBe(google.printStore.out);
       });

  test('a deployment for a declared profile, under it: the runtime uses it',
       async () => {
         const {google, vanilla} = await bothFlavors(
             [prod(`${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraphs/commerce`)], 'prod');
         expect(codes(google))
             .toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 0, skills: 0});
         expect(codes(vanilla)).toEqual(codes(google));
         expect(vanilla.printStore.out.split('\n').pop())
             .toBe('acme-ops/prod/commerce');
       });

  test('a deployment for an undeclared profile: every runtime command refuses',
       async () => {
         const {google, vanilla} = await bothFlavors([
           dev,
           {name: 'prod', target: `${SPANNER_DB}2/propertyGraphs/commerce`,
            profile: 'prdo'},
         ]);
         expect(codes(google))
             .toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
         expect(codes(vanilla)).toEqual(codes(google));
         expect(vanilla.printStore.out).toContain(
             "deployment 'prod' names unknown binding profile 'prdo'; " +
             'defined profiles: prod.');
       });

  test('a malformed deployment for another declared profile: every command refuses',
       async () => {
         const {google, vanilla} = await bothFlavors(
             [dev, prod(`${SPANNER_DB}/propertyGraph/typo`)]);
         expect(codes(google))
             .toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
         expect(codes(vanilla)).toEqual(codes(google));
         expect(vanilla.printStore.out).toContain("deployment 'prod' targets");
       });

  test('an extends that names an unknown entity: every command refuses',
       async () => {
         const {google, vanilla} = await bothFlavors([dev], undefined, ['Missing']);
         expect(codes(google))
             .toEqual({push: 1, report: 1, printStore: 1, skills: 1});
         expect(codes(vanilla)).toEqual(codes(google));
         for (const name of ['printStore', 'skills']) {
           expect(vanilla[name].out)
               .toContain("entity 'Order' extends unknown entity 'Missing'");
         }
       });
});
